violations.text: Employee observed putting on gloves and working with food without washing hands. Food employees must wash their hands before putting on gloves. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026
Spray bottle used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies was not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026

Working containers of spices and dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026
Ventilation hood grates observed with a build-up of grease and debris. Ventilation hood grates must be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2026
